title: Book One · Chapter 146: The First Invitation
story:
Ronan writes an invitation for Dad at school. The class has made other invitations. Those plain sheets give the date, place, and time. This card is just for Dad. This one has a small drawing of Dad's blue tool box.

He makes the handle twice before it looks right. Then he writes COME AND SEE OUR WORK. There is space below it. He thinks about the old-home picture and adds a tree in one corner.

Mei looks at it while she waits for glue.

“Is that tree in your street?”

“It was at our old home.”

“It has very large leaves.”

“They are Dad's hair.”

Mei smiles. “Then perhaps put him under it, not inside it.”

Ronan laughs and draws a little man below the tree. He thinks Dad will like that. It is a joke they know together.

At home Dad is late. Mum asks to read the invitation. Ronan gives it to her. She likes the blue box but asks about the tree.

“Dad has not agreed to the old-home picture yet.”

“This is only for him.”

“Then make that clear when you give it.”

Ronan puts it face down beside Dad's bowl. He waits until the door opens. Dad comes in with tired eyes and a little paper bag of screws. He sets them high, away from the edge, and washes his hands.

Ronan pushes the invitation towards him. “This one is yours.”

Dad reads it. His mouth lifts at the tool box. He puts one finger on the little man under the tree.

“He needs more hair.”

“He has the whole tree.”

Dad laughs. Ronan thinks Dad may say yes now. Dad might come to see the room. He might agree to the old picture too. Perhaps they could show a story about his work. “The drawing can go beside the map,” he begins.

Dad's smile becomes smaller.

“Which drawing?”

“Our old room. With the tree.”

“I am still thinking about that.”

“People will like it.”

“That is not the only question.”

Mum takes a hot bowl from the cooker. She puts it down, then sits at the other side of the table. Ronan looks at the invitation. Dad liked the invitation. Then Ronan began asking about the old picture too. That was a different question. Now Dad is not smiling.

“This is only yours,” he says again. “I have not put the old picture on the list as yes.”

Dad nods. He stands the invitation against his tea cup. Now he can see it while he eats.

After supper Ronan sees him put it inside the lid of the blue tool box. It will be there when he opens the box for work.

Does Dad plan to come? Ronan wants to ask him. Instead he lets Dad close the lid. He can ask more tomorrow. Dad liked the card, but he has not promised to come. Ronan waits while Dad puts the box away.

Before he leaves the room, he takes his display list from his bag. The old picture still says WAIT. He moves his finger along the word. He does not use a pencil. Then he shuts the book. Dad liked his invitation. That does not mean he agreed to show the old picture. Ronan leaves WAIT on the list.

He goes outside to throw the ball once more before dark. Dad comes to the doorway and catches it on the second throw. Ronan leaves the papers inside. For a while, he and Dad just throw the ball.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：invitation＝邀请卡；face down＝正面朝下；make that clear＝把这件事说明白。

情节提示：glue＝胶水；screws＝螺丝钉；lid＝箱盖。

理解：1. 给 Dad 的邀请卡为什么和班级那批不同？2. Dad 的笑容为什么还不能算同意公开旧画？
